'''Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site''' (cmikehardy.tripod.com) was a Northern California / Alderaan-region fan site run by [[Carl "Mike" Hardy|Mike Hardy]], Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Red 32 FL (Pleasanton, California). The live Tripod URL is dead; the working copy is the Wayback snapshot of 13 May 2021.

Hardy billed it as a Squadron Member site: events, strategy, rulings scraped from listserves and the Current Rulings Document, visitor-submitted deck designs, card reviews, a player database and tournament-director locator, contests, and the monthly ''Galactic Archives'' newsletter for people not on the Alderaan listserve.

The January 2001 homepage also records:

* A [[Radio Free Decipher]] spoiler of [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]] (Reflections II).
* 2001 organized-play changes: tournament directors allowed to play in their own events; year-to-date ratings; a separate ranking for closed environments such as Battle of Endor (BOE); four-month "sprints."
* Decipher's Bruce Umene visiting Northern California tournaments over the holidays.
* A Reflections II box-opening party at Krier's Cards & Comics hosted by Todd Feldman.
* "Squadron Member Bounty" contest (Anthony Ricioli listed with a "Kill Stripe" for beating World Finalist Kevin Shannon).
* AlderaanHQ@egroups.com regional list.
* Membership in the '''Decipher Squadron Members Webring''' (ring id 23). Links out to Bill Yak's Final Conflict (<code>billyak.com/fc/</code>) and The Asylum GeoCities repository (<code>geocities.com/Area51/Capsule/3345/</code>).
